conbody.p: Buyback of shares refers to repurchase of shares by the company from its existing shareholders. During the buyback, the company usually offers a higher price to the shareholders. However, participation in a share buyback is voluntary. The shares acquired by a company in buyback are extinguished and this results in reduction of share capital. Buyback of securities are governed by SEBI (Buy-Back of Securities) Regulations, 2018.
